notes.title: random patch 3
notes.notes:

anyway enjoy hope youre having a good week

notes.title: first patch wow!!!
notes.notes:
hey all. first post-release patch is up. heres what i did

- added support for cloud saves (works between steamdeck/windows too)

- added the first round of basic cheevos, fun challenge stuff later!

- made it so the ball moves at 75% speed on Easy Mode

- fixed(?) the audio bug in a certain boss fight. might not have fixed it. we will see



if your progress gets reset somehow by the cloud sync,
check your %APPDATA% 10S FOREVER folder
if theres a save.game file in there, copy it to the playdata subfolder
this is probably fixed but somebody had an issue so letting you know



thanks for playing <3

-chloe
